mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_print_template (tenant_id, application_id, template_code, template_name, source_type, source_key, page_id, form_key, object_code, draft_schema, draft_revision, design_status, published_version_id, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{applicationId}, #{templateCode}, #{templateName}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceKey}, #{pageId}, #{formKey}, #{objectCode}, #{draftSchema}, #{draftRevision}, #{designStatus}, #{publishedVersionId}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{createDept}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_print_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT FROM sys_print_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, tenant_id, application_id, template_code, template_name, source_type, source_key, page_id, form_key, object_code, draft_revision, design_status, published_version_id, status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_print_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND application_id = #{applicationId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_print_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND application_id = #{applicationId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_print_template SET template_name = #{row.templateName}, draft_schema = #{row.draftSchema}, draft_revision = draft_revision + 1, design_status = CASE WHEN published_version_id IS NULL THEN 'DRAFT' ELSE 'CHANGED' END, update_by = #{row.updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND id = #{row.id} AND del_flag = 0 AND draft_revision = #{expectedRevision}

UPDATE sys_print_template SET published_version_id = #{versionId}, design_status = 'PUBLISHED', draft_revision = draft_revision + 1, update_by = #{actor}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND status = 1 AND draft_revision = #{expectedRevision} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_print_template_version v WHERE v.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND v.template_id = #{id} AND v.id = #{versionId} AND v.del_flag = 0)

UPDATE sys_print_template SET status = #{status}, draft_revision = draft_revision + 1, update_by = #{actor}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND draft_revision = #{expectedRevision} AND #{status} IN (0, 1)

UPDATE sys_print_template SET del_flag = id, draft_revision = draft_revision + 1, update_by = #{actor}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND draft_revision = #{expectedRevision} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_print_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.template_id = #{id} AND b.del_flag = 0)
